chunks: And Muḥammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ al-Kinānī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a man and a woman who are found in a single blanket, so he said: "Flog them, one hundred lashes, one hundred lashes."

key_terms.لِحَافٍ وَاحِدٍ: a single blanket or shared covering

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling in a hadith from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام about a man and woman found under one blanket?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man and a woman found together under a single blanket. The Imam عليه السلام states that each of them is to receive one hundred lashes, making the report relevant to discussions of hadd and ta'zir in Shi'i fiqh.
